title: Surreal Fantasy Seascape
description: A vibrant surreal fantasy scene depicts a red swirling sea with two Viking-style longships carrying fantasy characters. In the foreground a woman in blue kneels on a stone platform operating a glowing blue hourglass device. A massive demonic dragon emerges from a gothic castle with glowing pink windows while a wizard in red and blue casts magic. The sky contains a golden sun, a green planet, floating musical notes, and a black cracked moon-like object.
